title: India Looks to Build on Recent Victory Against England
summary: India is set to face England in the second One Day International (ODI) match, following their recent victory in the series opener. The English team aims to improve its performance with the bat, while India looks to build on its success. The match will be played at a neutral venue, and both teams are expected to field strong lineups.
summary_points: India has won the first ODI match against England in the series opener.
The English team is looking to improve its performance with the bat in the second ODI match.
India aims to build on its recent victory and continue its winning streak.
Both teams are expected to field strong lineups in the second ODI match.
The match will be played at a neutral venue, away from home advantage.
title_hi: भारत और इंग्लैंड के बीच दूसरा वनडे मैच
summary_hi: भारत ने पहले वनडे मैच जीत हासिल किया है, अब वह इंग्लैंड के खिलाफ दूसरे वनडे मैच में भाग लेगी। इंग्लैंड टीम अपनी बैटिंग में सुधार करने की कोशिश कर रही है।
summary_points_hi: भारत ने पहले वनडे मैच जीत हासिल किया है।
इंग्लैंड टीम अपनी बैटिंग में सुधार करने की कोशिश कर रही है।
भारत दूसरे वनडे मैच में भाग लेगा और अपनी जीत पर ध्यान केंद्रित रखेगा।
मैच एक निरन्तर स्थल पर खेला जाएगा, जहां घरेलू फायदे नहीं होंगे।

framing.left: Left-leaning outlets emphasize the importance of India's recent victory and its potential impact on the team's morale. They also highlight the challenges England faces in improving its batting performance.
framing.center: Centrist coverage focuses on the neutral venue of the match, the strong lineups expected from both teams, and the competitive nature of the ODI series.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on individual player performances, such as Shubman Gill's comments on India's 2027 World Cup blueprint, and highlight the team's ability to bounce back from a T20 flop.
